text: Why Standard Meds Failed You If you have tried SSRIs (antidepressants) and failed, you are not crazy. In a small trial of male combat veterans with severe, long-term PTSD, Prozac did no better than a placebo (Hertzberg, et al, 2000). Trials in veterans have been mixed since, and the VA still recommends sertraline and paroxetine (VA/DoD, 2023), so they help some people, just not everyone. And the side effects are well-known, including anhedonia, zombification, and sexual dysfunction.
reader: someone with trauma or in withdrawal who is anxious, wired, numb or foggy, wanting to know what is going on in their brain and which of the protocol's tools does what
